crossRefs.note: One who had escaped came and told Abram, the Hebrew. At that time, he lived by the oaks of Mamre, the Amorite, brother…
Yahweh appeared to him by the oaks of Mamre, as he sat in the tent door in the heat of the day.
Sarah died in Kiriath Arba (also called Hebron), in the land of Canaan. Abraham came to mourn for Sarah, and to weep…
Jacob came to Isaac his father, to Mamre, to Kiriath Arba (which is Hebron), where Abraham and Isaac lived as…
He said to him, “Go now, see whether it is well with your brothers, and well with the flock; and bring me word again.”…
They went up by the South, and came to Hebron; and Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, the children of Anak, were there. (Now…
Joshua blessed him; and he gave Hebron to Caleb the son of Jephunneh for an inheritance.
to the place of the altar, which he had made there at the first. There Abram called on Yahweh’s name.
Noah built an altar to Yahweh, and took of every clean animal, and of every clean bird, and offered burnt offerings on…
Yahweh appeared to Abram and said, “I will give this land to your offspring.” He built an altar there to Yahweh, who…
He left from there to go to the mountain on the east of Bethel and pitched his tent, having Bethel on the west, and Ai…
I have set Yahweh always before me. Because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.
I desire therefore that the men in every place pray, lifting up holy hands without anger and doubting.

people.name: Abraham
people.line: Patriarch, chosen by God to father His people

people.name: Hebron
people.line: An important city in Judah; burial place of patriarchs.

people.name: Mamre
people.line: A place near Hebron; associated with Abraham

translations.web: Abram moved his tent, and came and lived by the oaks of Mamre, which are in Hebron, and built an altar there to Yahweh.
translations.bsb: So Abram moved his tent and went to live near the Oaks of Mamre at Hebron, where he built an altar to the LORD.
translations.kjv: Then Abram removed his tent, and came and dwelt in the plain of Mamre, which is in Hebron, and built there an altar unto the LORD.
translations.asv: And Abram moved his tent, and came and dwelt by the oaks of Mamre, which are in Hebron, and built there an altar unto Jehovah.
